intro: You are a salvage diver in Brinemouth, a stilt-town built on the roofs of a drowned glass city. The city below is full of treasure, songs, and things that should have stayed asleep. You work in a crew. You are always short of money.

origins.name: Reefborn
origins.about: Raised on the stilt-towns, in and out of the water since you could walk.
origins.gift: Once a scene, ignore one Crack on a Swim roll.

origins.name: Lampkin
origins.about: A child of the lamp guilds who keep the old lights burning.
origins.gift: You can read the old city's guild marks.

origins.name: Driftfolk
origins.about: From the boat clans who never stay in one harbour.
origins.gift: You always know which way is up, and the way out.

callings.name: Hookhand
callings.about: The crew's fighter: hook, line and stubbornness.

callings.name: Lampwright
callings.about: Keeper of the crew's light, and its mender.

callings.name: Shellrunner
callings.about: Scout and harpooner, first in and first out.

abilities.name: Brace the Line
abilities.effect: Anchor an ally: they ignore the next current, push or Snare this scene.

abilities.name: Steady Light
abilities.effect: Standard roll. Your lantern burns white: clear Blinded from the crew, and things below that hate light lose 2 dice until your next turn.

abilities.name: Slip the Current
abilities.effect: Standard roll. Move anywhere close and vanish from sight; your next attack this scene gains +2 dice.

gear.name: Gaff hook
gear.about: A long pole with a hook and a blade.

gear.name: Harpoon gun
gear.about: Spring-loaded; one shot, then an action to reload.

chargen: Choose an origin, and add its stat bonus.
Choose a calling: it gives you two skills at rank 1, your gear and an ability.
Every stat starts at 1. Spend 6 more points (none above 4).
Spend 6 skill ranks (none above 2 at the start, counting your calling's ranks).
Name your diver, describe them in a line, and say what they want.

pregens.name: Moll Tarrow
pregens.look: Scarred knuckles, a quick grin, a hook over one shoulder.

pregens.name: Ivo Glim
pregens.look: Soot on his fingers, a lantern older than he is.
pregens.want: Find the guild that lit the drowned city.

pregens.name: Sefa Rook
pregens.look: Small, quiet, braids full of fish-hooks.
pregens.want: Never be in debt to anyone.
